resources.string: The phone has no network. Turn off airplane mode, or find Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Tailscale looks like it\'s off on this phone. Start it, and the hub can reach the phone again.
Another VPN seems to be on. Tailscale can\'t run beside it. Turn that VPN off, and start Tailscale.
The phone is on the tailnet, but the hub isn\'t answering. Is the laptop on and awake?
The phone is on the tailnet.
No app on this phone can open the download page. Install Tailscale from Google Play, or open this address in a browser: %1$s
Confirm the phone\'s name first. The hub knows the phone by it, and it can\'t pair until it\'s set. Two phones of one model would get the same suggestion, so check it.
The phone is now known by this name.
A name may have small letters, digits and hyphens, must start with a letter, and be at most 32 long.
The phone already has another name. Changing it means clearing the app\'s data and pairing again.
The phone could not save the name. Free some space, and try again.
Pairing code: %1$s\nIt works once, for 10 minutes. Showing a new one ends it.\nThe phone\'s tailnet address: %2$s
The listener is running, but Android hides its notice. Tap to show it.
